title: Doomsday Trailer Fuels Young Avengers Theories and Raises a Thor Concern
excerpt:
Kate Bishop's appearance alongside the previously known Cassie Lang strengthens team-up speculation.
A line from Thor also revives worries about the film's enormous cast.
body_md:
A ComicBook.com analysis of the final Avengers: Doomsday trailer highlights Kate Bishop's appearance as a possible step toward the Young Avengers. Cassie Lang was already known to be involved, and seeing both characters in the same major Marvel event gives renewed momentum to a long-running fan theory.

Marvel has introduced several younger heroes across its films and series, including Ms. Marvel, Ironheart and members of the Maximoff family. They have not yet been established as a unified team in the way fans have anticipated. The article suggests that developments following the Multiverse Saga could create an opportunity for that to change.

A potential Young Avengers lineup is speculation, not an official team announcement. Kate's presence in the trailer is the more concrete development, while any future group formation remains uncertain.

The article also examines a line in which Thor says he does not know half the heroes fighting alongside him. That comment echoes an existing fan concern: the movie brings together so many characters that introductions and explanations could compete with the emotional impact of the central story.

The writer contrasts this challenge with the established relationships that helped Avengers: Infinity War and Avengers: Endgame resonate. Still, the line does not prove that Doomsday will struggle with its ensemble. It is possible for the film to use unfamiliarity between heroes as part of its narrative.

Other trailer material touches on Steve Rogers, Peggy Carter and the X-Men. The article lists a December 18, 2026 theatrical release. For now, the footage supports discussion of Kate's involvement and Thor's dialogue, while the future of the Young Avengers and the effectiveness of the ensemble remain open questions.
